dedupe_keys.name: dataset of flooded underpasses on italy s urban road networks in the last 80 years

description: A National Research Council team publishes geolocated events in which Italian urban-road underpasses flooded. Zenodo provides CSV and KML data, a field-description document and a processing file under CC BY 4.0. The deposit describes 1,439 events from 1942–2023, assembled over twenty-four months from news, social media and research sources. Recorded attributes include warning systems, affected vehicles and people, and actions taken during an incident. These observations can serve as inputs in road-flood exposure and emergency-routing simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this event collection. Coverage is reported Italian incidents, not a complete underpass register or a denominator of all uneventful crossings. A limitation is that event reporting has changed over eight decades and location precision varies by source. Social-media or newspaper reports need independent checking for critical decisions. No CSV or KML was downloaded, and no event count was recalculated.
